title: Drop support for HS256 JWTs
author: NyanKiyoshi
body_preview: Saleor currently supports JWT signing using HS256 which uses `SECRET_KEY`. This requires a sufficiently strong secret thus making HS256 security dependent on the entropy and the adequate protection of that secret.  Instead, it would preferable to only allow RS256 in order to ensure the secret is sufficiently strong.  Proposal: fully drop HS256 in a new minor version. This will require users to ens...

author: tranthanhsongitrepo
